top_signals.title: Building an Arsenal That Survives the Tenth Salvo
top_signals.summary:
America faces a well-defined industrial base problem. Whether it’s a hypothetical Taiwan invasion wargame run two dozen times, the current Iranian conflict, or the Russo-Ukrainian War, the same result repeats: Magazines of key weapons such as cruise missile systems and interceptors empty within days, weeks, or months, and the current industrial base takes years to replenish them. top_signals.title: Singapore DPM: Must Work Faster to Vie With Wealth Hubs
top_signals.summary: Singapore must work faster and harder as it competes with other global hubs that manage wealth says the island nation's Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong.  He added that as global supply chains and investment flows shift, Singapore’s important role as a financial hub will provide further opportunities.  The Deputy Prime Minister spoke with Haslinda Amin at the New Economy Forum in New Delhi. (Source: Bloomberg)
